country.title: Country
country.description: 2-letter code of the EU country that issued the TIN, e.g. DE, FR, IT, NL (Greece: EL or GR).

tin.title: TIN
tin.description: The tax identification number, without a country prefix. Spaces, dots, dashes and slashes are ignored. Leave empty when you use 'TINs (batch)'.

tins.title: TINs (batch)
tins.description: Up to 200 items per run: [{"country": "DE", "tin": "..."}, ...]. Clear the single 'TIN' field when you use this.
